cards.card_text: Then he's to sprinkle blood from the altar and anointing oil on Aaron and his sons and on their garments.
cards.verse_text: And take some of the blood on the altar and some of the anointing oil and sprinkle it on Aaron and his garments, as well as on his sons and their garments.

cards.card_text: Moses is to sprinkle blood from the altar and anointing oil on Aaron, his sons and their garments.
cards.verse_text: And take some of the blood on the altar and some of the anointing oil and sprinkle it on Aaron and his garments, as well as on his sons and their garments.

cards.card_text: He takes some of its blood into the Tent of Meeting, sprinkles it seven times before the LORD in front of the veil, and puts some on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense.
cards.verse_text: The priest is to dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle some of it seven times before the LORD, in front of the veil of the sanctuary.

cards.card_text: Then the anointed priest runs the same steps: blood into the Tent, seven sprinkles in front of the veil, blood on the horns, the rest at the base, fat on the altar.
cards.verse_text: Then the anointed priest is to bring some of the bull’s blood into the Tent of Meeting, and he is to dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD in front of the veil.

cards.card_text: If someone offers it in thanksgiving, he brings unleavened cakes, unleavened wafers, cakes of fine flour and cakes of leavened bread with it, and one portion of each goes to the priest who sprinkles the blood.
cards.verse_text: It belongs to the priest who sprinkles the blood of the peace offering.

cards.card_text: Moses sprinkles some of the anointing oil on the altar ___ times.
cards.verse_text: He sprinkled some of the oil on the altar seven times, anointing the altar and all its utensils, and the basin with its stand, to consecrate them.

cards.card_text: He sprinkles them on Aaron and his sons and on their ___.
cards.verse_text: Next, Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood that was on the altar and sprinkled them on Aaron and his garments, and on his sons and their garments.

cards.card_text: How many times does he sprinkle the one being cleansed?
cards.verse_text: Seven times he shall sprinkle the one to be cleansed of the skin disease.

cards.card_text: Then he sprinkles some of the oil seven times before the LORD and puts oil on those same spots, right on top of the blood.
cards.verse_text: Then the priest shall take some of the log of olive oil, pour it into his left palm, dip his right forefinger into the oil in his left palm, and sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD.

cards.card_text: He dips the live bird, the cedar wood, the hyssop and the yarn in the blood and the fresh water, and he sprinkles the house seven times.
cards.verse_text: Then he shall take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the scarlet yarn, and the live bird, dip them in the blood of the slaughtered bird and the fresh water, and sprinkle the house seven times.

cards.card_text: Still behind the veil, Aaron sprinkles the bull's blood with his finger on the east side of the mercy seat, then seven times in front of it.
cards.verse_text: And he is to take some of the bull’s blood and sprinkle it with his finger on the east side of the mercy seat; then he shall sprinkle some of it with his finger seven times before the mercy seat.

cards.card_text: He sprinkles it like the bull's blood He pours it out beside the ark He mixes it into the incense
cards.verse_text: Aaron shall then slaughter the goat for the sin offering for the people and bring its blood behind the veil, and with its blood he must do as he did with the bull’s blood: He is to sprinkle it against the mercy seat and in front of it.

cards.card_text: He puts some of the bull's blood and the goat's blood on all the horns of the altar and sprinkles it seven times.
cards.verse_text: He is to sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times to cleanse it and consecrate it from the uncleanness of the Israelites.

cards.card_text: Aaron puts blood on the altar's horns and sprinkles it seven times.
cards.verse_text: He is to sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times to cleanse it and consecrate it from the uncleanness of the Israelites.

cards.card_text: First, Moses is to sprinkle the Levites with the water of purification.
cards.verse_text: This is what you must do to cleanse them: Sprinkle them with the water of purification.

cards.card_text: Eleazar takes some of its blood on his finger and sprinkles it toward the front of the Tent of Meeting.
cards.verse_text: Eleazar the priest is to take some of its blood on his finger and sprinkle it seven times toward the front of the Tent of Meeting.

cards.card_text: Eleazar sprinkles the heifer's blood ___ times toward the front of the Tent of Meeting.
cards.verse_text: Eleazar the priest is to take some of its blood on his finger and sprinkle it seven times toward the front of the Tent of Meeting.

cards.card_text: Then a man who is ceremonially clean dips hyssop in the water and sprinkles the tent, its furnishings and the people who were there.
cards.verse_text: Then a man who is ceremonially clean is to take some hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle the tent, all the furnishings, and the people who were there.

cards.card_text: The clean man sprinkles the unclean person on the third day and on the seventh day.
cards.verse_text: The man who is ceremonially clean is to sprinkle the unclean person on the third day and on the seventh day.

cards.card_text: The one who sprinkles the water of purification must wash his clothes, and whoever touches that water is unclean until evening.
cards.verse_text: This is a permanent statute for the people: The one who sprinkles the water of purification must wash his clothes, and whoever touches the water of purification will be unclean until evening.

cards.card_text: They all sprinkle dust on their heads, and I think every one of them is heartbroken.
cards.verse_text: Then Joshua tore his clothes and fell facedown before the ark of the LORD until evening, as did the elders of Israel; and they all sprinkled dust on their heads.

cards.card_text: Then it flips: He will sprinkle many nations, and KINGS will shut their mouths because of Him.
cards.verse_text: so He will sprinkle many nations.

cards.card_text: God says He'll sprinkle clean water on Israel and cleanse them from all their impurities and all their ___.
cards.verse_text: I will also sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean.

cards.card_text: If the blood of goats and bulls and the ashes of a heifer, sprinkled on people who are ceremonially unclean, make their bodies clean…
cards.verse_text: For if the blood of goats and bulls and the ashes of a heifer sprinkled on those who are ceremonially unclean sanctify them so that their bodies are clean,

cards.card_text: What does he sprinkle?
cards.verse_text: For when Moses had proclaimed every commandment of the law to all the people, he took the blood of calves and goats, along with water, scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled the scroll and all the people,

cards.card_text: Besides the scroll and the people, what else does Moses sprinkle with blood?
cards.verse_text: In the same way, he sprinkled with blood the tabernacle and all the vessels used in worship.

cards.card_text: The writer says their hearts have been sprinkled clean.
cards.verse_text: let us draw near with a sincere heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled to cleanse us from a guilty conscience and our bodies washed with pure water.

cards.card_text: Last on the list is sprinkled blood.
cards.verse_text: to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.

cards.card_text: True or false: The writer says the sprinkled blood speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.
cards.verse_text: to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.
